name: Bean Simulator
author: WorkSteve7284
description: You have been placed in prison for being a bean. Collect the gems and escape through the bars in the ceiling. WASD to move, shift to sprint, and mouse to look. If you can't jump, restart the game. If you fall down through the parkour, restart the game. The doors may or may not work. This was intended to be a fun and easy parkour game, but now it is a rage game.
